label: STANDARD_OF_FAVOURING_1: the betterness ranking read as value
definition: A ValueStandardOrder is a ranking of candidates in each variation scenario read as value: its field better s x y says that x is a better good than y at s. The field is a declared primitive relation: Lean does not type value. The structure is distinct from EndRealizationOrder, so a value order and an end-realization order are different types and passing from one to the other needs an explicit construction from the other's relation. Examples: a candidate arrangement that benefits its recipients more than another ranks above it. Non-examples: lower action of a path, greater weight, realizing a given end content D (each may coincide with value at a scenario without being it). Nothing in the record says that value factors through end-realization or that it varies within an end-realization class; the latter is the open premise BetternessVariesWithinEndClass.
